motion: I THEREFORE MOVE that the Department of Transportation (LADOT), the Bureau of Engineering (BOE), the Bureau of Street Services (BSS), and the Bureau of Street Lighting (BSL) provide a current list of the City's active transportation projects and associated grant deadlines, including, but not limited to, protected bicycle lanes and paths, pedestrian safety improvements, neighborhood greenways, and sidewalk improvements associated with corridor upgrades, prioritizing projects that are located on the City's High Injury Network, improve access to transit stations, major job centers, and key entertainment and sporting venues, serve disadvantaged communities, are located along the Festival Trail or extend the existing network ofnon~vehicular paths. I FURTHER MOVE that the Council instruct the City Administrative Officer, with assistance from LADOT, BOE, BSS, and BSL, to identify adequate staffing levels and evaluate funding options, including the feasibility of utilizing Municipal Improvement Corporation of Los Angeles (MICLA) lease revenue bonds, that would provide the necessary staff resources and project implementation costs to deliver the City's active transportation projects. title: Current List of Active City Transportation Projects and Associated Grant Deadlines / Identify Adequate Staffing Levels and Evaluate Funding Options

requests.asks: Provide a current list of the City's active transportation projects and associated grant deadlines, prioritizing projects on the High Injury Network, improving access to transit, serving disadvantaged communities, and extending non-vehicular path networks.

Identify adequate staffing levels and evaluate funding options, including the feasibility of utilizing MICLA lease revenue bonds, to provide necessary staff resources and project implementation costs for the City's active transportation projects.
